About.heading: A Private Escape Closer to Nature
About.paragraph1: Villa Lemon is a collection of handpicked villas nestled in the serene landscapes of Varkala, Kerala. Surrounded by lush greenery, tranquil views, and the soothing sounds of nature, our villas offer the perfect blend of luxury, privacy, and authentic local charm.
About.paragraph2: Whether you're here to relax, reconnect, or celebrate, we ensure every moment is thoughtfully curated for your comfort.
About.natureDesc: Villas surrounded by lush greenery and breathtaking views.
About.luxuryDesc: Spacious villas with modern amenities designed for ultimate comfort.
About.serviceDesc: Dedicated 24/7 support to make your stay smooth and memorable.
About.everyoneDesc: Ideal for families, couples, friends, and special occasions.
About.quoteText: We don't just offer stays, we create unforgettable experiences.

HostRetreat.hostTitle: Host Your Retreat at Villa Lemon
HostRetreat.hostIntro: We provide private, premium homestay accommodation combined with a tranquil rooftop yoga hall, homely catering services, and reliable airport transfers. Use our interactive dashboard below to plan your room layout, customize meals, select logistics, and draft a proposal request.
HostRetreat.roomsFeatureDesc: Distributed across two adjacent phases. Offers comfortable options ranging from standard ground-floor units to premium deluxe rooms with private balconies.
HostRetreat.hallFeatureDesc: Shared rooftop studio equipped with yoga mats, blocks, natural fresh air, and excellent natural lighting. Holds a capacity of 15 to 18 participants.
HostRetreat.mealsFeatureDesc: Homestyle vegetarian, vegan, and gluten-free menus cooked fresh. Flexible meal options, including full day packages and customizable retreat group menus.
HostRetreat.selectRoomsIntro: Select the rooms you require below. For each room, customize the occupancy and bed configuration options.
HostRetreat.largeBedOrTwoSingle: 1 large bed (6 ft × 6 ft) or 2 single beds
HostRetreat.largeBedOrTwoSingleClassic: 1 Large Bed (6 ft × 6 ft) or 2 Single Beds (6 ft × 3 ft each)
HostRetreat.diningIntro: Choose a meal package that suits your group schedule. We cook fresh daily on-site and offer full menu personalization.
HostRetreat.fullDayOption: Full Day Vegetarian Menu (Breakfast + Lunch + Dinner)
HostRetreat.dietaryNotesLabel: Dietary Restrictions & Special Menu Customization Requests
HostRetreat.dietaryNotesPlaceholder: List any specific menu directions (e.g. Gluten-free, vegan, allergies, South Indian/Continental options)...
HostRetreat.customGroupMenusCheck: We would like to customize the menu for our retreat groups (South Indian, North Indian, and Continental options)
HostRetreat.airportLogisticsIntro: We provide airport pick-ups/drop-offs in comfortable vehicles and can rent yoga props or schedule extra yoga sessions.
HostRetreat.yogaHallSessionsLabel: Retreat Yoga Sessions per Day (Rooftop Sala Included)
